raw_response:
I will keep cotton as my main crop because my farm is small at 18.4 mu, I have long experience with it, and well irrigation gives me enough control to support it through the key stages. Since my household labor is limited and some family labor is tied up off-farm, I will not spread myself too thin with overly intensive management on every plot. I will put the largest share of land into cotton for income, and I will keep smaller areas in wheat and maize to balance cash flow, rotation needs, and household grain security. I will use better seed on all three crops, stay with moderate fertilizer rates rather than chasing maximum input use, irrigate only when the crop response is clear, and rely on rotary tillage because it is practical for my scale and fits how I would manage labor and field preparation. My target is steady, manageable production with controlled input costs, not the highest possible yield on paper.
